POST Progress Image API

/api/progress-image

Generate custom progress report images with skills, XP, loot, and runtime data.

📋 Overview

The Progress Image API generates beautiful progress report images for OSRS scripts and activities. It supports custom styling, multiple skills, loot tracking, and runtime statistics.

Features

  • Custom Script Names: Display your script or activity name
  • Multiple Skills: Track XP gains across multiple skills
  • Loot Tracking: Include items obtained with quantities
  • Runtime Statistics: Show session duration and efficiency
  • Professional Styling: Clean, modern design with OSRS theme
  • High Resolution: Crisp images suitable for sharing

📊 Request Format

The API expects a JSON payload with the following structure:

{ "script_name": "Seers Agility", "runtime": 60, "xp_earned": [ {"skill": "agility", "xp": "126,585"} ], "loot": [ {"id": 249, "name": "Guam leaf", "count": 43} ] }

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Description
script_name string Yes Name of the script or activity
runtime number Yes Session duration in minutes
xp_earned array No Array of skill XP gains
loot array No Array of items obtained. Each item must include: id (number), name (string), and count (number)

📊 Response Format

The API returns a JSON response with the generated image data:

{ "success": true, "image_url": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAA...", "message": "Progress report generated successfully" }
